payload.title: the judge clip has two homes
payload.body: At 31a7cfce (unit purview-contest of refusal-way-forward) the judge-payload cap and clip are defined twice: guard-shell.ts exports judgePayloadCapBytes and judgeClipShell for the purview worker, while stance-guardrail.ts still defines its own judgePayloadCapBytes = 12_000 and judgeClipShell and exports them as stanceGuardrailJudgeCap and stanceGuardrailJudgeClip, which stance-guardrail-pre.ts imports. Before the unit there was one home. Two copies of the bound on what a guard hands its judge can drift apart; the stance units of the same plan are the natural place to fold the stance workers onto guard-shell.ts.
